controller.objective: Equalize smoothed acceptance rates across prompt classes.

mlp.extrapolation: Linear interpolation through batch 1/8/32; the 8-to-32 slope extends to batch 64.

limitations: The service model inherits all E49-E52 limitations and is not a live serving-engine measurement.
The controller optimizes equal prompt-class acceptance, not tenant, token, or utility-weighted fairness.
Cumulative smoothed feedback assumes a stationary class mixture and does not model abrupt tenant or workload drift.
Gain and credit bounds are a sensitivity sweep, not an automatically tuned production controller.
Rejected requests leave immediately and are not retried, routed to another replica, or queued in a reservation class.
model: The E52 hard-100ms, 8x-safety controller with explicit online equal-class acceptance deficits.

validation.accounting: The v40 base asserts exact accepted prefill/decode tokens, causal pairs, finite completion only for accepted requests, max batch 64, and KV within budget. Every admitted request satisfies its dynamic safety-adjusted threshold and hard slices report zero budget violations.
